556:t_4:32.en:
$$かなめ$$
「This... is the world I wished for.」

556:t_4:33.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「No... You wished for a world with nothing in it...!」

556:t_4:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...At first, I wanted to go back eighteen years and wish for a peaceful world without fighting, too.」

556:t_4:35.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then I'd live happily with my family, meet him as an ordinary high school boy... $$相良$$, and fall in love...」

556:t_4:36.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But... in that world, he wouldn't have the scar on his cheek...」

556:t_4:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That one-of-a-kind scar the days of brutal fighting left on him...」

556:t_4:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The boy I want isn't that $$相良$$...」

556:t_4:40.en:
$$かなめ$$
「A cruel, merciless world of destruction and slaughter... The boy who grew up amid its war and chaos...」

556:t_4:43.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That's why I'm going back. To that world.」

556:t_4:45.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「You're going to let him die!? Him and your mother!? Abandoning everyone and doing nothing is a terrible sin!」

556:t_4:46.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Even so, there's... nothing I can do anymore.」

556:t_4:47.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「There is! Play the melody of rebirth now! You can't give up!」

556:t_4:48.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「You're trying to run away! You're trying to throw it all away!」

556:t_4:49.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm not throwing anything away. I haven't given up, either.」

556:t_4:50.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Even if the world ends a minute from now, I'll keep moving forward for that minute... That's what gives it meaning.」

556:t_4:51.en:
$$かなめ$$
「He does... with his friends, as the person he is now, in the world he lives in now...」

556:t_4:52.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The value lies in his will to believe that, as the person he is.」

556:t_4:54.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll keep living. In a world without him.」

556:t_4:55.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「That's just self-deception! Don't you think you're being selfish!?」

556:t_4:56.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「How can you refuse to use a way to bring the dead back to life when you have one!?」

556:t_4:57.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Even if there really is a way... that must be... a power we shouldn't use...」

556:t_4:58.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「What about him... $$宗介$$!? You'll regret this!」

556:t_4:59.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm sure he'll accept this! Because...!」

556:t_4:60.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Because... he'd never fall for a girl who whines and tries to start over.」

556:t_4:61.en:
$$かなめ$$
「He couldn't risk his life for a girl like that! That's why... That's why I...!」

556:t_4:63.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll... show him I've got guts!」

556:t_4:65.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I can... live my life just fine even without $$宗介$$.」

556:t_4:66.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll forget you right away, find a better guy, and make myself really, really happy...」

556:t_5:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Draw your knife. We're both out of bullets, so we'll settle this in close combat.」

556:t_5:4.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I never thought you'd follow me.」

556:t_5:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I thought I should settle this with my own hands.」

556:t_5:6.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「When did you become such a romantic?」

556:t_5:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm under no obligation to answer.」

556:t_5:8.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You seem prepared to be caught in the $$時空震動$$.」

556:t_5:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I came prepared to take you down with me, at least. ...If you have an excuse, I'll hear it.」

556:t_5:10.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You'll get angry no matter what I say.」

556:t_5:14.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「What's wrong? Can't you fight without an AS?」

556:t_5:16.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I've taught you how to fight, but there's something I've thought for a long time.」

556:t_5:19.en:
$$宗介$$
(I don't need him to tell me that. ...I'm certainly no genius.)

556:t_5:20.en:
$$宗介$$
(I can't match the Major in close combat. Plenty of people are better than me at sniping and piloting ASes, too.)

556:t_5:23.en:
$$宗介$$
(At best, it's my stubbornness when I'm cornered!)

556:t_5:29.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「What's wrong? Aren't you going to finish me off?」

556:t_5:31.en:
$$宗介$$
(There's no way I could kill the Major...)

556:t_5:32.en:
$$宗介$$
(To me, the Major is... my father...)

556:t_5:33.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...That's why I said you have no talent.」

556:t_5:35.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You're a lamb raised in a pack of wolves.」

556:t_5:36.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You have no thirst for blood or need to devour flesh, yet you've pretended to be a wolf... You had to, to survive.」

556:t_5:37.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Where else could you find a creature so warped, so tragic?」

556:t_5:39.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You shouldn't be doing this. You should never have become a man called $$カシム$$ or $$ウルズ$$ 7.」

556:t_5:40.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「There must have been a place where you truly belonged...」

556:t_5:41.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Ever since I pulled you from that crashed airliner, then saw you again on the battlefield years later, I've felt that way.」

556:t_5:45.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...This is... my last lesson for you...」
